MATCH (s:Sculpture)-[r:HAS_GENRE|BELONGS_TO|OF_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: "roundabout art"})

MATCH (s:Sculpture)

RETURN s.name AS sculptureName, s.country_of_origin AS countryOfOrigin
